title: a build of the project shadows a user build with the same id, by id and whole: nothing of the user file is merged
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). The nearest layer that has an id decides: the project's haiku-explorer is the build of that id, so the user folder's haiku-explorer.yaml (another description, model and effort) is never listed, never launched and never merged into it. A positive control keeps the case meaningful: the user-only build next to it is listed with its origin. The oracle never reads the user folder, so it passes the shadowing half and FAILS on the user-only line.

stdout.regex: (?m)^- user-only: claude-haiku-5-5 low\. A build that only the user folder has\. requires: nothing \(from user ~/\.jitso/builds/user-only\.yaml\)$
(?m)^- haiku-explorer: claude-haiku-5-5 low\. Read-only search of the repo that returns file paths and line numbers\. requires: nothing$
